0022600121.text: The Bulls (1-2, 11th in the East, 4th in the Central and 2 games back) visit the Celtics (1-1, 8th in the East, 3rd in the Atlantic and 1 game back), with Chicago on a one-game losing streak and 1-1 on the road. Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are out for the Bulls, and Devin Carter (illness) is out for Boston. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost 1-2 in the season series, including a 124-105 loss in Boston on February 11, 2026.
